result.description: A fictional 27-inch studio display built for color-critical illustration, page layout, and general productivity. It uses a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel with factory-calibrated sRGB coverage, a matte anti-glare coating, and a fully adjustable stand with pivot, swivel, tilt, and height control. Connectivity includes DisplayPort, HDMI, and USB-C with 65W power delivery, plus a simple USB hub for desk accessories.
result.title: Morrow Vale 27" IPS Studio Monitor
